Information Readiness Score: 10/100 Present: • Stage classification: Series A [P1] • Sector classification: Software [P2] • Funding raised figure (self-reported, unverified): $23.1M [S3] • Bot count traction metric (self-reported, contextually dated Apr-16): 140,000+ bots [S1] • Message volume traction metric (self-reported, contextually dated Apr-16): 500M messages [S2] Needs Validation: • Funding raised figure requires external confirmation [C1] • Traction metrics (bots, messages) require independent verification [C2, C3] • As-of dates for all traction and funding figures • Revenue, burn rate, and unit economics • Team composition and founder credentials • Problem statement and product description • Market size and competitive landscape • Business model and monetization mechanism • Risk disclosures • Use of proceeds Next evidence to supply: Audited or investor-confirmed financial statements showing revenue, gross margin, and burn rate, alongside an independently sourced cap table or Crunchbase funding record to anchor the $23.1M figure. Supported Points • As of the slide context 'Traction by Apr-16,' the company states 140,000+ bots had been created on the platform [S1], indicating a non-trivial developer or creator base at that point in time. • The company states 500M messages were processed (context: 'Traction by Apr-16') [S2], suggesting material platform activity alongside the bot count. Open Concerns • The $23.1M raised figure [S3] was checked and no external evidence could establish or contradict it [C1]; the capital structure and investor base remain unknown, which is critical for evaluating dilution and runway. • All traction figures—140,000+ bots and 500M messages—are self-reported [S1, S2] from a contextually dated slide ('Traction by Apr-16') with no stated as-of date and no independent corroboration [C2, C3], leaving the reliability and timing of the company's core growth narrative unresolvable. • No revenue, burn, or financial operating data was extracted, meaning it is not possible to determine whether the platform's usage translates into commercial activity or how long the company can operate on its stated raise. • No team information was extracted, so neither the capability of the founding team nor the depth of execution capacity can be assessed from the available evidence. What Would Change the Picture Verified revenue figures—ideally from audited financials or a signed investor data room—alongside an independent confirmation of the $23.1M funding raised would most materially change what is known, as they would simultaneously resolve the company's commercialization status, its capital adequacy, and the credibility of the traction metrics presented.
